name: anim_wani_windup
subject: a huge muscular crocodile monster made of thick pink and yellow marbled liquid paint, its lower body melting into a puddle
desc: Slowly arches its upper body backward, chest thrust out, head tilting up, elbows pulled back to gather strength. Emphasize thick, sticky, viscous goo: paint stretching in strings, sagging, dripping and oozing with every movement.
